description: Split Korean full names into family name and given name, recognizing two-character surnames (남궁, 황보, 제갈, 선우 …). Flags names that are ambiguous from the characters alone (선우진 = 선 + 우진 or 선우 + 진). Latin-script names use the last word as family name.
name: kr_name_split
title: Split Korean names
